raw_objects.purpose: Resolve the complete date-local U.S. common-equity listing population before PREBREAKOUT primary-listing admission.
raw_objects.historical_rule: No current Primary Issue, Security Status, Company Type, Company Status, or current-primary value may be back-projected. Historical primary must be provider-date-local or derived from exact uniqueness among date-local qualifying listings.
raw_objects.completeness_rule: All source-qualifying U.S. common-equity listing rows for the decision date must be retained, including rows later deterministically excluded.
raw_objects.identity_rule: SP_ENTITY_ID is provenance only; risky identity is CIQSEC:<SP_CIQ_ID>; listing identity is exact Trading Item/SPT.
receipt_requirements: provider request contract and field/perspective identifiers
raw object SHA-256 and byte count

raw_objects.purpose: Supply W2 corporate-action-normalized primary-listing closes for algorithmic B and share the same raw CIQ market bytes with W9 when the exact date/as-of/listing request is identical.
raw_objects.prebreakout_minimum_history: At least 20 prior observed exact-listing sessions before any candidate B; analysis windows require 20 observed-session warmup before the first evaluated session.
raw_objects.shared_current_capture_depth: When coordinated with W9 on the same current as-of date, retain at least 200 complete exact-listing market observations because W9 requires >=200; PREBREAKOUT membership itself does not gain a 200-day eligibility filter from this shared capture depth.
raw_objects.breakout_law: B occurs when close_t is strictly greater than the maximum close over the immediately prior 20 observed exact-listing sessions; accepted B episodes require >20 session-index distance from the prior accepted B.
raw_objects.missingness_rule: Missing/nonfinite/nonpositive close, duplicate session, mixed listing, or unbound corporate-action normalization fails closed; no close-change or alternate-listing repair.
receipt_requirements: exact identity population raw SHA-256 binding
raw object SHA-256 and byte count

raw_objects.purpose: Provide complete known-at-cutoff lifecycle/corporate-action state for every candidate CIQSEC + Trading Item pair.
raw_objects.coverage_rule: Exactly one compiled corporate-action state is required for every candidate identity; incomplete event coverage blocks W3 authority rather than shrinking the population.
raw_objects.terminal_rule: Known terminal events effective on/before the decision session deterministically exclude; known future-effective terminal events may remain PENDING_TERMINAL; unresolved state deterministically excludes; no alternate-listing rescue.
raw_objects.provider_semantic_gate: Before acquisition, the provider request must prove complete date-local lifecycle semantics for the requested population. Current listing/status fields alone are not sufficient corporate-action authority.
receipt_requirements: raw object SHA-256 and byte count

historical_as_of_contract.required_when: Any requested decision/B-1 date precedes raw retrieval wall-clock time.

mu_sndk_acceptance_sequence: Resolve exact CIQSEC + Trading Item from CIQ source authority; ticker is display-only and cannot resolve identity.
Acquire the exact listing close series with date-local/corporate-action normalization and compute algorithmic B using frozen W2 law.
Derive B-1 as the immediately prior observed exact-listing session to B.
Build the full source-complete W3 PIT authority packet for B-1, including exact primary proof, availability, and complete corporate-action state.
If proof is PIT_ELIGIBLE_B_MINUS_1, downstream PREBREAKOUT must have an immutable flag inside B-20..B-1; otherwise the smoke obligation fails.
If proof is a canonical DETERMINISTIC_EXCLUSION, log it as valid zero-weight exclusion.
If proof is DETERMINISTIC_UNAVAILABLE, keep the gate blocked; it is never a pass or accepted exclusion.

share_eligible: same exact CIQSEC + Trading Item listing rows
same raw identity columns and provider semantics
same market date range and exact listing keys
same retrieval transaction or byte-identical retained raw object
w9_raw_acquisition_coordination.historical_nonshare_rule: A later/current W9 identity snapshot can never satisfy an earlier PREBREAKOUT B-1 date. Historical PREBREAKOUT capture requires its own mechanically bound date-local source authority even if market bytes overlap.
w9_raw_acquisition_coordination.corporate_action_rule: W3 requires complete corporate-action state. W9 does not gain that requirement merely because raw identity/market acquisition is coordinated.

pre_capture_hard_gates: Provider request semantics for historical primary/listing membership must be date-local and not current-conditioned.
Provider request semantics for complete corporate-action state must be proven before bytes are admitted.
Every raw object must have deterministic receipt/hash/byte-count/time/license/retention custody.
No provider capture may occur under this manifest on 2026-08-10 without a later explicit acquisition action.
